# Health Data

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../), one of its top concepts._

Personal health and diabetes data from websites and HealthKit collected from my wearable devices and iOS apps.

## Scope note

- Includes Dexcom Clarity website with Dexcom API for glucose data.
- Includes Glooko website with PDF download containing Omnipod 5 insulin pump data.
- Includes Apple Health with health data from multiple apps.
